adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a raw HTML rendering path that bypasses the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline: Post#cook now returns `raw` verbatim when `cook_method == :raw_html` (app/models/post.rb), and TopicEmbed.import creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `skip_validations: true` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). The embed view then renders with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb), which will output that verbatim HTML in the embed page. The RSS polling path passes `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` directly into TopicEmbed.import (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb) and the only transformation shown is `absolutize_urls`, which only rewrites leading-`/` href/src and does not sanitize/remove dangerous tags/attributes or `javascript:` URLs (app/models/topic_embed.rb). This is sufficient to support the finding’s stored XSS concern in the embed page.
